name: dsh-docdesk
description: An add-only multi-format materials library for DeepSeek Harness: pick Markdown, text/code, HTML, images, PDF, audio and video from workspaces, place icons on a fixed non-overlapping desktop grid, marquee-select and move groups with trailing drags, swap folders and drop onto a breadcrumb path, read anything full-screen with browser-style tabs and an immersive mode, and keep Markdown's GFM tables, Mermaid/chart blocks, bookmarks, persistent last-read bar and 3-second line highlights while text/code, sandboxed HTML with same-folder assets, image zoom with Shift+wheel and click-to-full-screen, labelled path-bar actions, PDF and native media viewers cover the other formats; formats a browser cannot preview are not listed. · DSH 资料区：主动挑选 Markdown、纯文本/代码、HTML、图片、PDF、音频和视频，在固定网格桌面内对齐摆放，支持右键框选整组拖动、文件夹交换、路径投放、沉浸式全屏阅读与标签页切换；Markdown 提供 GFM 表格、Mermaid/图表代码块、上次阅读提示、滚动条书签标记和跳转高亮，其余格式各有阅读器（HTML 沙箱并读取同目录资源、Shift+滚轮缩放与点按全屏图片、PDF、音视频），路径栏按钮带文字标签，浏览器无法预览的格式不会列出。
